name: Moonlight Headless Patch
description: Lets Moonlight-based mods load under HeadlessMC. Moonlight's SpriteUtils.parsePaletteStrip reads pixel data from textures during resource reload; with LWJGL/STB stubbed every image decodes empty and it throws 'has too few colors'. This returns a placeholder palette instead, and skips Supplementaries' globe refresh outright. Inert on a normal client and when the target mods are absent.
